# TC.MonitorResize

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.MonitorResize"></a>

### TC.MonitorResize

Logical terminal geometry changed. Old wrappers/coordinates may no longer be
valid; rediscover and inspect dimensions. Notifications may coalesce to the
latest geometry while retaining the original prior dimensions.

Extends: TC.MonitorEvent

### height

Current terminal height in character rows.

```text
integer
```

### name

Resize event discriminator.

```text
'monitor_resize'
```

### old_height

Previous terminal height in character rows.

```text
integer
```

### old_width

Previous terminal width in character columns.

```text
integer
```

### reason

Cause of geometry/scale notification.

```text
'tiles'|'scale'
```

### width

Current terminal width in character columns.

```text
integer
```
